title: Clarify source-bound merge handoffs and reviewer traceability
body:
## Purpose
Make the **existing** review/merge boundary source-bound and traceable without introducing a new CI gate or interrupting live feature branches.

- Treat the SHA embedded in CONTINUATION as the **last reconciled source baseline**: the current production tip comes from Git itself. A commit cannot include its own final SHA in its committed document.
- Require the existing designated reviewer’s verdict, reviewed head/base, blockers/disposition and CI link to be attributed on the PR; distinguish a relayed reviewer report from a submitted GitHub review.
- During each normal merge, reconcile CONTINUATION and WORKBENCH where state/next work changes, or record that neither needs an update; fetch landed production and continue dispatching.

## Safety / integration
**Docs-only (AGENTS.md and docs/AGENT_BRIEF.md).** No gameplay, toolchain, CI workflow, signing, current production state, active worker branches or current open gameplay PR changed. Existing `guidance` and docs-only `game-smoke` checks remain the only gates. Deliberately left as a **draft PR** for review and integration at a normal boundary, without asking any active agent to stop. Root should check the latest user directive and production tip before accepting. No human playtest gate.

Base at drafting: `92814c21132d3e9babb649172024ca67881b1df9`.
